To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) online resources about dementia are not always easy to read; 2) online resources about static dementia information are easier to read than online resources about interactive dementia information; 3) the readability level of online resources about static and interactive dementia information is higher than the average readability level in the general public; and 4) online resources about interactive information are less likely to be written in a language that can be understood by the general population.
